source_evidence.quote:
## What the repeated wholes look like

Thirteen recurrent strings are doubletons and two are tripletons. Only three
repeat inside one array:

- `okeod`: slots 8, 12 and 21 of the f69 28-member radial array;
- `okal`: slots 3 and 5 of the f72 16-member ring, plus one f67 occurrence;
- `okaly`: slots 4 and 12 of that same f72 ring.

These collisions reject unique-member or unique-day readings for those exact
strings. They remain compatible with a repeated status, ruler, phase or entry
class.
